sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: My name is Bruce Schoenfeld and I'm a contributor to the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我叫布鲁斯·舍恩菲尔德，是《纽约时报》杂志的撰稿人。

sentences.en: I've been writing about baseball for four decades.
sentences.zh: 我写棒球报道已经四十年了。

sentences.en: And my most recent piece for the magazine is about one of the sport's biggest evolutions in all that time.
sentences.zh: 我为该杂志撰写的最新文章，讲述的是这段时间里这项运动发生的最大演变之一。

sentences.en: It has to do with some of the marquee stars of Major League Baseball.
sentences.zh: 这与美国职业棒球大联盟的一些大牌明星有关。

sentences.en: Starting pitchers.
sentences.zh: 先发投手。

sentences.en: Starting pitchers are throwing fewer innings per game than ever.
sentences.zh: 先发投手每场比赛投球的局数比以往任何时候都少。

sentences.en: The act of throwing a baseball 90 to 95 miles an hour off a mound is not natural.
sentences.zh: 从投手丘上以90到95英里的时速投出棒球，这并不符合生理自然规律。

sentences.en: A pitcher's arm undergoes an enormous amount of physical stress.
sentences.zh: 投手的胳膊承受着巨大的身体压力。

sentences.en: And the body needs time to recover from that.
sentences.zh: 身体需要时间从中恢复。

sentences.en: Just how much time no one can seem to agree on, despite years and years of accumulated knowledge and data.
sentences.zh: 尽管经过多年积累了丰富的知识和数据，但没人能就具体需要多少时间达成一致。

sentences.en: Today's baseball is heavily optimized by data.
sentences.zh: 今天的棒球运动在很大程度上被数据优化了。

sentences.en: Anyone who has been following the sport for more than a few years can see how the study and use of that data has changed the game.
sentences.zh: 任何关注这项运动超过几年的人都能看出，对这些数据的研究和使用是如何改变比赛的。

sentences.en: For example, the data says that bunting isn't that beneficial, so almost nobody ever bunts anymore.
sentences.zh: 例如，数据显示牺牲触击并不划算，所以现在几乎没人再用触击了。

sentences.en: And this optimized version of baseball also dictates that if there's any doubt, take the starting pitcher out of the game before something bad happens.
sentences.zh: 这种优化版的棒球规则还规定，如果有任何疑虑，就在坏事发生前把先发投手换下场。

sentences.en: The longer he goes, it turns out, the more likely he'll give up hits and runs.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他投得越久，就越有可能被安打和失分。

sentences.en: Or even worse, get tired and maybe injure himself.
sentences.zh: 甚至更糟的是，他可能会疲劳，甚至可能受伤。

sentences.en: And so, when a game might be at a decisive point in the late innings, these days starting pitchers are rarely still around.
sentences.zh: 因此，当比赛进入后半局的关键时刻，如今很少能看到先发投手还在场上。

sentences.en: But then, last year, a starting pitcher named Paul Skeens made his debut in the major leagues.
sentences.zh: 但去年，一位名叫保罗·斯金斯的先发投手在大联盟首次亮相。

sentences.en: He struck him out with 100!
sentences.zh: 他用100英里的球速三振了他！

sentences.en: Paul Skeens!
sentences.zh: 保罗·斯金斯！

sentences.en: He has faced four Cubs.
sentences.zh: 他已经面对了四名小熊队的打者。

sentences.en: He has struck out each of them to begin his day.
sentences.zh: 他开场就三振了他们每一个人。

sentences.en: He's incredibly exciting to watch and draws huge crowds nearly every time he takes the mound.
sentences.zh: 看他投球令人无比兴奋，他几乎每次登上投手丘都能吸引大批观众。

sentences.en: Here it is.
sentences.zh: 就是这一球。

sentences.en: Swing and a foul tip!
sentences.zh: 挥棒，擦棒被捕！

sentences.en: He struck him out!
sentences.zh: 他三振了他！

sentences.en: That's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 简直不可思议。

sentences.en: It is absolutely incredible.
sentences.zh: 这绝对令人难以置信。

sentences.en: Skeens throws the ball 100 miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 斯金斯的投球时速高达100英里。

sentences.en: He has four pitches that he's able to put where he wants.
sentences.zh: 他有四种球路，都能投到他想投的位置。

sentences.en: And he's adding two more this year.
sentences.zh: 今年他还增加了两种。

sentences.en: After the season, last summer, he was named the National League's Rookie of the Year.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天赛季结束后，他被评为国家联盟年度最佳新秀。

sentences.en: He has struck out seven.
sentences.zh: 他已经完成了七次三振。

sentences.en: Derek Shelton going to remove Skeens, and we'll just listen to the reaction as he heads the dugout.
sentences.zh: 德里克·谢尔顿准备换下斯金斯，我们来听听他走向休息区时观众的反应。

sentences.en: They're already starting to stand before he even gives up the...
sentences.zh: 他甚至还没放弃……观众就已经开始起立了。

sentences.en: But even though Skeens might be this once-in-a-generation talent, unless something changes, it's likely that he'll be largely absent from the record books.
sentences.zh: 但尽管斯金斯可能是这种一代一遇的天才，除非情况有所改变，否则他很可能在记录簿上几乎销声匿迹。

sentences.en: And that's what's at the center of my story and this week's Sunday Read.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我的报道以及本周《周日阅读》的核心所在。

sentences.en: Baseball's had a resurgence lately.
sentences.zh: 棒球运动最近出现了复苏。

sentences.en: But one of the unintended consequences of the sport's devotion to analytics is that marquee pitchers, like Paul Skeens, don't play nearly as significant a role.
sentences.zh: 但该运动对分析数据的痴迷所带来的意想不到的后果之一，就是像保罗·斯金斯这样的明星投手，所起的作用远没有以前那么重要了。

sentences.en: And that means fans simply don't get the chance to see those magical pitchers nearly as much as they used to.
sentences.zh: 这意味着球迷们根本没有机会像过去那样频繁地看到那些神奇的投手。

sentences.en: Is there anything Major League Baseball can do to fix that?
sentences.zh: 美国职业棒球大联盟能做些什么来解决这个问题吗？

sentences.en: So here's my article, narrated by Robert Fass.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的文章，由罗伯特·法斯朗读。

sentences.zh: 我们的音频制作人是杰克·迪西多罗。

sentences.zh: 我们的音乐由亚伦·埃斯波西托创作并演奏。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: One day at Wrigley Field last May, Paul Skeens was pitching for the Pittsburgh Pirates, carving out a small piece of baseball history in his second big league game.
sentences.zh: 去年五月在瑞格利球场的一天，保罗·斯金斯代表匹兹堡海盗队先发，在他大联盟生涯的第二场比赛中，书写了一段小小的棒球历史。

sentences.en: Just two years before, he was a sophomore at the Air Force Academy, learning to fly C-17 transport planes in preparation for a career in the military.
sentences.zh: 就在两年前，他还是空军学院的一名大二学生，学习驾驶C-17运输机，为未来的军旅生涯做准备。

sentences.en: Now he was dominating the Chicago Cubs.
sentences.zh: 现在，他正在压制芝加哥小熊队。

sentences.en: He struck out the first seven batters he faced.
sentences.zh: 他三振了他面对的前七名打者。

sentences.en: By the end of the fifth inning, he had increased his strikeout total to ten.
sentences.zh: 到第五局结束时，他的三振总数已达到十次。

sentences.en: More impressive, he hadn't allowed a hit.
sentences.zh: 更令人印象深刻的是，他没有让对手打出一支安打。

sentences.en: To end the sixth, Skeens unleashed a fastball that was foul-tipped into the catcher's glove for an eleventh strikeout.
sentences.zh: 第六局结束时，斯金斯投出一记快速球，被击球手擦棒击入捕手手套，完成了第十一次三振。

sentences.en: The Cubs remained hitless.
sentences.zh: 小熊队依然没有安打。

sentences.en: At that point, Skeens had thrown exactly 100 pitches.
sentences.zh: 此时，斯金斯刚好投了100球。

sentences.en: He wouldn't throw another.
sentences.zh: 他不会再投下一球了。

sentences.en: When the Pirates took the field in the bottom of the seventh, Pittsburgh's manager, Derek Shelton, replaced him with Carmen Majinski.
sentences.zh: 当海盗队在第七局下半场上场时，匹兹堡队主教练德里克·谢尔顿用卡门·马金斯基换下了他。

sentences.en: No-hitters are not wildly uncommon.
sentences.zh: 无安打比赛并非极其罕见。

sentences.en: Since 1901, when the American League was formed and rules were standardized, each season has averaged around two of them.
sentences.zh: 自1901年美国联盟成立且规则标准化以来，每个赛季平均会出现约两次。

sentences.en: But for most of the sport's history, they represented a peak expression of individual achievement on the mound.
sentences.zh: 但在该项运动的大部分历史中，它们代表了投手丘上个人成就的巅峰表现。

sentences.en: They weren't quite sacrosanct, but pulling a starter when he hadn't allowed a hit was sure to produce headlines and no small amount of animosity in the clubhouse.
sentences.zh: 它们虽然不完全是神圣不可侵犯的，但在投手没有被安打的情况下将其换下，肯定会登上头条，并在更衣室里引起不小的反感。

sentences.en: Now, here was Skeens, the most heralded young pitcher in years, three innings away from throwing a no-hitter in his second start.
sentences.zh: 现在，斯金斯这位多年来最受瞩目的年轻投手，距离他在第二次先发中投出无安打比赛只差三局。

sentences.en: It felt like an opening salvo by a future Hall of Famer.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像是一位未来名人堂成员的开场白。

sentences.en: Instead, he watched from the dugout as Majinski allowed a single to the third batter he faced, a short fly to left field, and all the drama of the day was gone.
sentences.zh: 然而，他只能在休息区看着马金斯基被第三名打者击出一支安打，那是一个飞向左外野的短飞球，这一天的所有戏剧性瞬间都随之烟消云散了。

sentences.en: When I asked Skeens about that, he noted that in his first start the week before, he had been removed after 84 pitches.
sentences.zh: 当我问及此事时，斯金斯指出，在前一周他的第一次先发中，他在投了84球后就被换下了。

sentences.en: The fact that they let me go 100 in Chicago, he told me recently at the Pirates' spring training base in Bradenton, Florida, was even more than they were planning on.
sentences.zh: 他最近在佛罗里达州布雷登顿的海盗队春训基地告诉我，他们能在芝加哥让他投到100球，已经比他们计划的要多了。

sentences.en: And no hitter or not, 100 pitches is pretty much the most anyone gets to throw these days.
sentences.zh: 而且不管是不是无安打比赛，100球基本上就是如今任何人能投的极限了。

sentences.en: Over the past two decades, analysts have identified a treasure trove of competitive advantages for teams willing to question baseball's established practices.
sentences.zh: 在过去的二十年里，分析师们为那些愿意质疑棒球既定做法的球队，挖掘出了一座竞争优势的宝库。

sentences.en: Eventually, that meant every team.
sentences.zh: 最终，这意味着每一支球队都加入了进来。

sentences.en: Sacrifice bunts, for example, squander the game's signature currency, outs.
sentences.zh: 例如，牺牲触击浪费了比赛中最宝贵的资源——出局数。

sentences.en: Though spending an out increases the chance of scoring a run, it makes the kind of big inning on which games often turn far less likely.
sentences.zh: 虽然消耗一个出局数增加了得分的机会，但它使得比赛往往依赖的那种大局得分变得可能性更小。

sentences.en: But perhaps the most significant of competitive advantages was hidden in plain sight, at the center of the diamond.
sentences.zh: 但也许最显著的竞争优势就隐藏在众目睽睽之下，就在钻石球场的中心。

sentences.en: Starting pitchers were traditionally taught to conserve strength so they could last deep into games.
sentences.zh: 先发投手传统上被教导要节省体力，以便能支撑到比赛后期。

sentences.en: Throwing 300 innings in a season was once commonplace.
sentences.zh: 在一个赛季中投球300局曾经是常态。

sentences.en: In 1969 alone, nine pitchers did it.
sentences.zh: 仅在1969年，就有九名投手做到了这一点。

sentences.en: But at some definable point in each game, the data came to reveal, a relief pitcher becomes a more effective option than the starter.
sentences.zh: 但数据揭示，在每场比赛的某个明确节点，后援投手会成为比先发投手更有效的选择。

sentences.en: Even if that starter is Sandy Koufax or Tom Seaver or Paul Skeens.
sentences.zh: 即使那个先发投手是桑迪·库法克斯、汤姆·西弗或保罗·斯金斯。

sentences.en: That moment usually comes in the sixth or seventh inning, once hitters have had several opportunities to size up the pitches that the starter is throwing.
sentences.zh: 那个时刻通常出现在第六局或第七局，一旦打者们有几次机会去观察先发投手投出的球路。

sentences.en: Waiting in the bullpen these days are a cadre of specialists with fresh, powerful arMs.
sentences.zh: 如今在牛棚里等待的是一群拥有充沛体力和强力手臂的专家。

sentences.en: They all throw 100 with a wipeout slider, the Texas Rangers' second baseman Marcus Simeon told me.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯游骑兵队的二垒手马库斯·西米恩告诉我，他们都能投出100英里的球速，还配有杀手级的滑球。

sentences.en: With a laugh, he added, I'll take the starter.
sentences.zh: 他笑着补充道，我还是会选先发投手。

sentences.en: Late in the game, Simeon seldom gets the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 在比赛后期，西米恩很少有机会面对他们。

sentences.en: This has become a problem for Major League Baseball, which needs all the stars it can find.
sentences.zh: 这已成为美国职业棒球大联盟的一个问题，因为他们需要尽可能多的明星球员。

sentences.en: In 1968, Bob Gibson started 34 games for the St. Louis Cardinals and finished 28 of them.
sentences.zh: 1968年，鲍勃·吉布森为圣路易斯红雀队先发了34场比赛，并完投了其中的28场。

sentences.en: In the process, he became a national celebrity.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，他成为了全国性的名人。

sentences.en: Last season, no pitcher managed more than two complete games.
sentences.zh: 上个赛季，没有投手能完成超过两场完投比赛。

sentences.en: Six times pitchers were pulled from games after the seventh inning when they had no hitters underway.
sentences.zh: 有六次，投手在第七局后被换下，尽管当时他们正处于无安打比赛的状态中。

sentences.en: It even happened to Skeens again later in the year, after seven innings at a July 11th game in Milwaukee.
sentences.zh: 这一幕后来在这一年里又发生在斯金斯身上，那是7月11日在密尔沃基的一场比赛，当时他投完了七局。

sentences.en: The drama of a pitcher's attempting to complete a no-hitter, battling not just fatigue but luck,
sentences.zh: 投手试图完成无安打比赛的戏剧性，不仅要对抗疲劳，还要对抗运气，

sentences.en: a bloop off the end of the bat can break up a no-hitter just as easily as a line drive, remains one of the game's greatest pleasures.
sentences.zh: 球棒末端的一个软弱无力的球和一支平飞球一样容易打破无安打记录，这仍然是这项运动最大的乐趣之一。

sentences.en: But with pitching injuries increasingly common, and the benefits of bringing in a reliever after going twice through the batting order
sentences.zh: 但随着投球伤病越来越普遍，以及在打者轮次过半后换上后援投手的优势

sentences.en: statistically unassailable, the circumstances under which starters are allowed to continue have dwindled.
sentences.zh: 在统计学上是无可辩驳的，先发投手被允许继续投球的情况已经越来越少。

sentences.en: Astonishingly, even a no-hitter is no longer reason enough.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊的是，即使是无安打比赛也不再是足够的理由。

sentences.en: In the heat of the moment, it feels short-term.
sentences.zh: 在当时的热烈气氛中，这感觉像是短视的。

sentences.en: Let's have something cool happen, says Craig Council, the Cubs manager.
sentences.zh: 小熊队主教练克雷格·康塞尔说，让我们发生点酷的事情吧。

sentences.en: But at the risk of someone's health, I don't think it's that cool.
sentences.zh: 但冒着某人健康的风险，我不认为这有多酷。

sentences.en: Skeens was a rookie last season, gratified to have made it to the majors.
sentences.zh: 斯金斯上赛季还是个新秀，能进入大联盟让他感到满足。

sentences.en: If Shelton wanted to protect his arm, who was he to argue?
sentences.zh: 如果谢尔顿想保护他的手臂，他又能争辩什么呢？

sentences.en: By mid-season, though, Skeens was a phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 然而到了赛季中期，斯金斯已经成为了一个现象级人物。

sentences.en: When he started a game at PNC Park, where the Pirates play, attendance jumped.
sentences.zh: 当他在海盗队主场PNC球场先发时，上座率就会飙升。

sentences.en: That matters for a club that hasn't won even half its games in any season since 2018.
sentences.zh: 对于一支自2018年以来任何赛季胜率都没能超过五成的俱乐部来说，这很重要。

sentences.en: The closest thing we've had to an event here in Pittsburgh since I arrived are the days that he pitches,
sentences.zh: 自打我来到匹兹堡，这里最接近盛事的就是他先发的日子，

sentences.en: says Ben Charrington, who has been the general manager of the Pirates since 2019.
sentences.zh: 自2019年以来一直担任海盗队总经理的本·查林顿说道。

sentences.en: After the season, Skeens, 22, won the National League's Rookie of the Year Award.
sentences.zh: 赛季结束后，22岁的斯金斯赢得了国家联盟年度最佳新秀奖。

sentences.en: At spring training in Florida this year, his image decorated a Pirates banner at Sarasota Airport and a flag that flapped from a lamppost in downtown Bradenton.
sentences.zh: 今年在佛罗里达州的春训期间，他的形象装饰着萨拉索塔机场的海盗队横幅，以及布雷登顿市中心灯柱上飘扬的旗帜。

sentences.en: That success confers some bargaining power.
sentences.zh: 这种成功赋予了他一定的谈判筹码。

sentences.en: Skeens told me that if he has a no-hitter going late in a game this season, and he feels strong enough, he'll ask to complete it.
sentences.zh: 斯金斯告诉我，如果本赛季他在比赛后期正处于无安打状态，且感觉体力充沛，他会要求完成比赛。

sentences.en: Still, Shelton is tasked with winning, not producing memorable moments.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，谢尔顿的任务是赢球，而不是制造难忘的时刻。

sentences.en: I understand that fans want to see guys come out for the 8th and 9th, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，我理解球迷们想看球员们投完第8局和第9局。

sentences.en: But he cautions that several variables need to line up for that to occur.
sentences.zh: 但他提醒说，要实现这一点需要多个变量同时满足。

sentences.en: He lists a few of them.
sentences.zh: 他列举了其中几个。

sentences.en: Is the game close?
sentences.zh: 比分接近吗？

sentences.en: Have the innings been stressful?
sentences.zh: 之前的局数投球压力大吗？

sentences.en: Is the bullpen rested?
sentences.zh: 牛棚的投手们休息好了吗？

sentences.en: Over the last few years, baseball has enjoyed a resurgence in popularity.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，棒球运动的受欢迎程度有所回升。

sentences.en: Rule changes have accelerated the game's pace, and a new generation of dynamic and enormously talented young players has arrived in the majors.
sentences.zh: 规则的改变加快了比赛节奏，新一代充满活力且天赋异禀的年轻球员已经进入了大联盟。

sentences.en: Still, the sport's decades-long trend toward cultural irrelevance remains worrisome.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这项运动几十年来向文化边缘化发展的趋势仍然令人担忧。

sentences.en: In that sense, MLB can hardly afford to marginalize some of its biggest names by putting them on the field,
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，MLB几乎无法承受将一些大牌球星边缘化的代价，让他们上场，

sentences.en: as Skeens was last season, only about 5% of the time, and almost never when a game's outcome was in doubt.
sentences.zh: 就像斯金斯上赛季那样，只有大约5%的时间，而且几乎从不在比赛胜负未定的时候。

sentences.en: For the importance of marquee starters to be revived,
sentences.zh: 为了重振明星先发投手的重要性，

sentences.en: baseball's executives must somehow persuade managers to act in a way that the data tell them is contrary to their team's best interests.
sentences.zh: 棒球高管们必须设法说服主教练们采取一种数据告诉他们与球队最大利益相悖的行为。

sentences.en: Skeens' arrival in Pittsburgh last summer as an instant standout brought that conflict between entertainment and strategic thinking into sharp focus.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天斯金斯来到匹兹堡并迅速脱颖而出，使娱乐性与战略思维之间的冲突变得更加尖锐。

sentences.en: Here was a pitcher who might have the ability to rank among the best of those who have preceded him, except that the sport itself won't let him.
sentences.zh: 这是一位可能拥有跻身前辈中最优秀行列能力的投手，只是这项运动本身不允许他这样做。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏《Connections》，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com/games开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: Rob Manfred, MLB's commissioner, remembers traveling to Yankee Stadium from upstate New York on an August weekend in 1968 to attend his first big league games.
sentences.zh: MLB专员罗布·曼弗雷德记得1968年8月的一个周末，他从纽约州北部前往洋基体育场观看他人生中的第一场大联盟比赛。

sentences.en: On Saturday, Mickey Mantle hit two home runs, but that was only the prelude.
sentences.zh: 周六，米奇·曼托打出了两支本垒打，但这只是序曲。

sentences.en: I was more excited about Sunday, Manfred says, because Mel Stottlemyre, his favorite pitcher, was starting for the Yankees.
sentences.zh: 曼弗雷德说，我对周日更兴奋，因为他最喜欢的投手梅尔·斯托特尔迈尔要为洋基队先发。

sentences.en: Stottlemyre, who had just thrown a shutout against the Oakland Athletics, had 15 wins and a sterling 2.27 ERA.
sentences.zh: 斯托特尔迈尔刚刚对奥克兰运动家队投出了一场完封比赛，拥有15场胜投和2.27的优异防御率。

sentences.en: The game turned out to be a buSt.
sentences.zh: 结果那场比赛成了一场灾难。

sentences.en: Stottlemyre allowed seven runs and was removed in the second inning.
sentences.zh: 斯托特尔迈尔丢了七分，在第二局就被换下了。

sentences.en: But Manfred, who was nine at the time, hasn't forgotten the anticipation he felt.
sentences.zh: 但当时年仅九岁的曼弗雷德，至今仍未忘记他当时感受到的那种期待。

sentences.en: To the extent that there's an erosion in the significance of that starter position, you lose that, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，在先发投手这一位置的重要性不断被削弱的情况下，你会失去那种期待感。

sentences.en: The average length of a pitching start these days is around five innings.
sentences.zh: 如今先发投手平均投球局数约为五局。

sentences.en: It's hard to base a decision to attend a game on a player who is going to participate in only half of it.
sentences.zh: 如果一名球员只能参与半场比赛，那么观众很难以此为由决定去现场看球。

sentences.en: This doesn't happen in other sports.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在其他运动中不会发生。

sentences.en: If you're at an NFL game and the score is close as it nears the end, you'll see the star quarterback leading his team down the field.
sentences.zh: 如果你在看一场NFL比赛，且比分在临近结束时非常胶着，你会看到明星四分卫带领球队在场上推进。

sentences.en: If you're watching the Golden State Warriors in the NBA playoffs, you won't see Stephen Curry benched after three quarters and held out for the rest of the game.
sentences.zh: 如果你在看NBA季后赛金州勇士队的比赛，你不会看到斯蒂芬·库里在三节过后就被换下场，并在余下的比赛中被雪藏。

sentences.en: To be sure, neither football nor basketball has a position so demanding that it requires players to skip games as part of a scheduled routine.
sentences.zh: 诚然，橄榄球和篮球都没有哪个位置要求高到需要球员在常规赛程中轮休。

sentences.en: There's already some inherent acceptance in our game that a starting pitcher is physically incapable of handling beyond a certain workload, says Mike Fitzgerald,
sentences.zh: 迈克·菲茨杰拉德说，我们的比赛中已经有一种内在的共识，即先发投手在身体上无法承受超过一定限度的负荷，

sentences.en: who oversees data analysis for the Arizona Diamondbacks.
sentences.zh: 他负责亚利桑那响尾蛇队的数据分析工作。

sentences.en: But it's debatable exactly what that workload is.
sentences.zh: 但这个负荷究竟是多少，还有待商榷。

sentences.en: What's not debatable is that the workload used to be far higher.
sentences.zh: 无可争议的是，过去的负荷要高得多。

sentences.en: They're trying to get you out of the game as quick as they can.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图尽快把你换下场。

sentences.en: Lance Lynn, who pitched for St. Louis last season, says of the data analysts, It doesn't matter what kind of effort you put in.
sentences.zh: 上赛季效力于圣路易斯红雀队的兰斯·林恩在谈到数据分析师时说：你付出什么样的努力并不重要。

sentences.en: They already have it planned.
sentences.zh: 他们早就计划好了。

sentences.en: The diminished status of the modern starter has put the traditional markers of excellence out of reach.
sentences.zh: 现代先发投手地位的下降，使得传统的卓越标志变得遥不可及。

sentences.en: 24 pitchers in baseball history have won 300 games, for example, but nobody else will.
sentences.zh: 例如，棒球史上只有24名投手赢过300场比赛，但以后再也不会有人达到了。

sentences.en: The outcomes of too many games are decided from the sixth inning onward, when the starters are already out.
sentences.zh: 太多的比赛结果是在第六局之后决定的，那时先发投手已经下场了。

sentences.en: I can't stand the direction of the game, with all the analytics legislating that you can't go three times through the lineup,
sentences.zh: 我无法忍受比赛的发展方向，所有的分析都在规定你不能让打者三次轮次面对同一投手，

sentences.en: says Max Scherzer, who pitches for the Toronto Blue Jays, and at 40 is nearing the end of a glorious career.
sentences.zh: 效力于多伦多蓝鸟队的马克斯·谢泽尔说道。40岁的他正处于辉煌职业生涯的尾声。

sentences.en: In 2018, Scherzer struck out 300 batters, one of only 19 pitchers since 1901 to achieve that feat in a season.
sentences.zh: 2018年，谢泽尔三振了300名打者，是自1901年以来仅有的19位单赛季达成此成就的投手之一。

sentences.en: There is not likely to be another.
sentences.zh: 以后恐怕很难再有这样的人了。

sentences.en: The loss to baseball transcends the statistical.
sentences.zh: 这对棒球的损失超越了数据层面。

sentences.en: Starting pitchers are now rarely involved in situations of high drama.
sentences.zh: 先发投手现在很少参与高潮迭起的比赛情境。

sentences.en: I'm saddened by it, says Jack Morris, a Hall of Famer whose epic ten-inning shutout won the World Series for the Minnesota Twins in 1991.
sentences.zh: 杰克·莫里斯说，我为此感到难过。这位名人堂成员在1991年凭借一场史诗般的十局完封，为明尼苏达双城队赢得了世界大赛冠军。

sentences.en: Really saddened in my soul.
sentences.zh: 发自内心地感到难过。

sentences.en: Will we ever see greatness again?
sentences.zh: 我们还能再见到伟大的表现吗？

sentences.en: I don't think we will, because pitchers are not allowed to be great.
sentences.zh: 我不认为会，因为投手们不再被允许变得伟大。

sentences.en: Only twice since he left El Toro High School in Lake Forest, California, has Skeen's thrown complete games for LSU against Mississippi State and Tulane in 2023.
sentences.zh: 自离开加州森林湖的埃尔托罗高中以来，斯基恩斯仅有两次为路易斯安那州立大学投出完投，分别是在2023年对阵密西西比州立大学和杜兰大学时。

sentences.en: But complete games aren't even the biggest issue.
sentences.zh: 但完投甚至不是最大的问题。

sentences.en: If starters routinely worked through the seventh or eighth inning and then gave way to closers, as tended to happen over the 20 or 30 years that preceded the rise of analytics,
sentences.zh: 如果先发投手像分析学兴起之前的二三十年那样，常规性地投满七局或八局，然后再交给终结者，

sentences.en: it's very likely that few fans would be disappointed.
sentences.zh: 那么很可能很少有球迷会感到失望。

sentences.en: Closers like the flamboyantly mustachioed Raleigh Fingers and the imposing Goose Gossage
sentences.zh: 像留着夸张胡子的罗利·芬格斯、气势逼人的古斯·高萨奇，

sentences.en: and the seemingly imperturbable Mariano Rivera are often oversized characters whose personalities enhance their roles.
sentences.zh: 以及看似波澜不惊的马里亚诺·里维拉这样的终结者，往往是个性鲜明的人物，他们的性格增强了其角色的魅力。

sentences.en: Perhaps the most exciting thing that happened at Citi Field last summer was when Edwin Diaz left the bullpen to the player of Blaster Jacks and Timmy Trumpets Narco
sentences.zh: 去年夏天在花旗球场发生的最令人兴奋的事情，或许就是埃德温·迪亚兹在《Narco》的伴奏下离开牛棚，

sentences.en: to get those final three outs and save a Mets game.
sentences.zh: 去拿下最后三个出局数并为大都会队保住胜果。

sentences.en: More frustrating are the innings before that, the eighth, the seventh, and increasingly the sixth.
sentences.zh: 更令人沮丧的是之前的局数，第八局、第七局，以及越来越多的第六局。

sentences.en: Instead of pitchers whom fans might buy tickets to see, they get a parade of anonymous relievers tasked with briefly throwing as hard as they can.
sentences.zh: 球迷们买票本想看那些投手，结果看到的却是一连串匿名的后援投手，他们的任务只是短暂地全力投球。

sentences.en: Not so long ago, those mid-game relievers were starters whose effectiveness had faltered.
sentences.zh: 不久前，那些中继投手还是表现下滑的先发投手。

sentences.en: On balance, they were no better, and usually worse, than a starter who had been through the batting order two or three times.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，他们并不比那些已经面对过两三次打者轮次的先发投手更好，通常反而更差。

sentences.en: But in recent years, that one inning of relief from a stronger pitcher in the middle of a game has become a specialty unto itself.
sentences.zh: 但近年来，由更强壮的投手在比赛中期投那一局后援，已经成为了一种专门的职能。

sentences.en: That's the shame right there, Scherzer says, that a starter can no longer go 105 pitches, which is seven innings at 15 pitches per inning, that we have to pull him out before that.
sentences.zh: 谢泽尔说，这才是最可惜的地方，先发投手不能再投105球了——按每局15球算就是七局——我们必须在那之前把他换下。

sentences.en: Many pitchers have strong feelings on the subject, but perhaps none express them quite as stridently as Scherzer.
sentences.zh: 许多投手对此有强烈的感受，但或许没有人像谢泽尔表达得如此尖锐。

sentences.en: We've got to develop starters again able to throw 100-plus pitches, he told me toward the end of last season.
sentences.zh: 我们必须再次培养能够投100球以上的先发投手，他在上赛季末对我这样说。

sentences.en: He was in a dugout at Globe Life Field in Texas, so agitated about the issue that he couldn't keep still.
sentences.zh: 当时他坐在德克萨斯州全球人寿球场的休息区里，对这个问题感到非常激动，以至于坐立难安。

sentences.en: That's what I keep telling them, he said.
sentences.zh: 我一直告诉他们这就是关键，他说。

sentences.en: I don't care how we do it, but we have to do it.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎我们怎么做，但我们必须做到。

sentences.en: He offered his solution, a combination of sticks and carrots.
sentences.zh: 他提出了自己的解决方案，一种胡萝卜加大棒的结合体。

sentences.en: If a starter doesn't throw 100 pitches, go six innings, or allow four runs, his team loses the designated hitter for the rest of the game.
sentences.zh: 如果先发投手投不满100球、投不满六局或失分超过四分，他的球队在余下的比赛中将失去指定打击。

sentences.en: For recalcitrant teams, Scherzer would also remove the runner who automatically starts each inning after the ninth in scoring position on second base,
sentences.zh: 对于顽固的球队，谢泽尔还会取消他们在九局后每局自动在二垒得点圈开始进攻的跑者，

sentences.en: creating a significant handicap.
sentences.zh: 从而制造一个巨大的劣势。

sentences.en: Once the starter qualifies, his team gets a free substitution, such as the ability to pinch run for a catcher who still gets to stay in the lineup.
sentences.zh: 一旦先发投手达标，他的球队将获得一次免费换人机会，例如可以为一名捕手代跑，而该捕手仍能留在阵容中。

sentences.en: Such changes would bring considerable upheaval to the game.
sentences.zh: 这样的改变将给比赛带来巨大的动荡。

sentences.en: But to Scherzer, who has no power to do anything beyond advocacy, the issue is existential.
sentences.zh: 但对于除了倡议之外无能为力的谢泽尔来说，这个问题关乎生死存亡。

sentences.en: Baseball's rise in popularity began after batters lost the right to specify whether each pitch would be delivered high or low.
sentences.zh: 棒球人气的上升始于打者失去了指定投球高低位置的权利之后。

sentences.en: That rule was changed in 1887, and almost immediately pitchers became the most important players on the field.
sentences.zh: 那条规则在1887年被修改，几乎立刻，投手就成了场上最重要的球员。

sentences.en: If the continued emphasis on throwing hard makes them all but interchangeable,
sentences.zh: 如果对全力投球的持续强调使他们变得几乎可以互换，

sentences.en: the unique confrontation of pitcher against hitter that constitutes the heart of the game will lose its intrigue.
sentences.zh: 那么作为比赛核心的投手与打者之间独特的对决，将失去其吸引力。

sentences.en: Scherzer has been proselytizing his argument for several years, as MLB has continued to study the issue with what appears to be more intellectual curiosity than urgency.
sentences.zh: 谢泽尔多年来一直在宣传他的观点，而美国职棒大联盟（MLB）似乎以一种好奇心而非紧迫感在研究这个问题。

sentences.en: To every member of all the committees, he says, and shakes his head, nobody listens.
sentences.zh: 他说，对所有委员会的每一位成员，他摇了摇头，没人听。

sentences.en: Scherzer is 6'6 and 260 pounds.
sentences.zh: 谢泽尔身高6英尺6英寸（约1.98米），体重260磅（约118公斤）。

sentences.en: That's large for a baseball player, even in the era of huge, multi-talented athletes, and would rank him among the two or three biggest pitchers in the Sports Hall of Fame.
sentences.zh: 即使在拥有众多全能巨星的时代，这对于棒球运动员来说也算高大，足以让他跻身体育名人堂中两三位最大的投手之列。

sentences.en: He was recruited to the Air Force Academy's baseball team to play catcher, but his size and strength made him an especially effective pitcher.
sentences.zh: 他曾被空军学院棒球队招募去当捕手，但他的体型和力量使他成为了一名特别有效的投手。

sentences.en: By the time he arrived there, he was already too large to fit inside the cockpit of a fighter jet, which was his original ambition.
sentences.zh: 当他到达那里时，他的体型已经大到无法塞进战斗机的驾驶舱了，而那曾是他最初的志向。

sentences.en: During his freshman season, he threw a pitch recorded at 100 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 大一赛季，他投出过时速100英里的球。

sentences.en: Though he continued to both pitch and catch, his future was settled.
sentences.zh: 尽管他继续投球和接球，但他的未来已经注定。

sentences.en: He would throw fastballs in the major leagues.
sentences.zh: 他将在大联盟投出快速球。

sentences.en: If he had stayed at Air Force past his sophomore year, he would have triggered an active duty commitment.
sentences.zh: 如果他在大二之后继续留在空军学院，他将触发服现役的义务。

sentences.en: Reluctantly, he transferred to LSU and pitched the Tigers to the 2023 College World Series title.
sentences.zh: 他无奈地转学到路易斯安那州立大学，并带领老虎队赢得了2023年大学世界大赛冠军。

sentences.en: The Pittsburgh Pirates, who held the first pick in the 2023 draft, coveted a hitter.
sentences.zh: 拥有2023年选秀状元签的匹兹堡海盗队，渴望得到一名打者。

sentences.en: If you asked me in March or early April who the number one would be,
sentences.zh: 如果你在三月或四月初问我谁会是状元，

sentences.en: Sherrington says, I'd have said, I don't know, but I can tell you it will be a position player.
sentences.zh: 谢林顿说，我会说，我不知道，但我可以告诉你那会是一名位置球员。

sentences.en: Pitchers are riskier, their amateur successes harder to extrapolate to the big leagues, and the Pirates already had several promising young starters.
sentences.zh: 投手风险更大，他们的业余成就很难推演到大联盟，而且海盗队已经有几位很有前途的年轻先发投手了。

sentences.en: And then, Sherrington continues, Paul just kept doing extraordinary things.
sentences.zh: 然后，谢林顿继续说道，保罗一直表现出非凡的能力。

sentences.en: Late in the college season, the model that the Pirates used to assess talent started projecting schemes as the top pick.
sentences.zh: 在大学赛季后期，海盗队用来评估人才的模型开始将斯基恩斯预测为状元人选。

sentences.en: We literally kept asking, can this be right, Sherrington says.
sentences.zh: 谢林顿说，我们真的不断在问，这可能是对的吗？

sentences.en: But it got to be clear enough in our system that it wasn't even close.
sentences.zh: 但在我们的系统中，这一点变得足够清晰，甚至没有悬念。

sentences.en: And it just became, this is a different kind of pitcher.
sentences.zh: 最后就变成了：这是一个不同类型的投手。

sentences.en: We should probably take him.
sentences.zh: 我们大概应该选他。

sentences.en: At first glance, Skeens looks like the most complete incarnation yet of a specific type of analytics-friendly pitcher.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，斯基恩斯看起来像是那种特定类型、符合分析学要求的投手最完美的化身。

sentences.en: One who seems purpose-built to hurl fastballs and sliders as hard as he can for as long as he can before ceding the mound to relievers.
sentences.zh: 他似乎就是为了尽可能用力、尽可能久地投出快速球和滑球，然后在把投手丘交给后援投手之前完成任务而设计的。

sentences.en: And at some level, that's what he is.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他确实如此。

sentences.en: But Skeens' path to becoming a top-pitching prospect was different from everyone else's.
sentences.zh: 但斯基恩斯成为顶级投手新秀的道路与其他人不同。

sentences.en: As a catcher, he wasn't exposed to a recruiting subculture that emphasizes pitch velocity and spin rate more than actually getting batters out in games.
sentences.zh: 作为一名捕手，他没有接触过那种比在比赛中真正解决打者更强调球速和转速的招募亚文化。

sentences.en: He wasn't on that summer grinder circuit and doing velo programs since he was four,
sentences.zh: 他没有参加过那种夏季磨练巡回赛，也没有从四岁起就参加球速训练项目，

sentences.en: Sherrington says, referring to training routines designed to increase pitch velocity.
sentences.zh: 谢林顿说，他指的是旨在提高球速的训练常规。

sentences.en: And maybe, Sherrington added, you start to think that he's this good because he didn't do all those modern pitcher things.
sentences.zh: 谢林顿补充道，也许你会开始认为他这么优秀是因为他没有做那些现代投手做的事情。

sentences.en: In fact, Skeens shows signs of evolving into another kind of pitcher, one in the image of those durable starters who preceded him.
sentences.zh: 事实上，斯基恩斯表现出进化成另一种投手的迹象，一种类似于他之前那些耐用先发投手的形象。

sentences.en: I do think that, knock on wood,
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，敲敲木头（祈求好运），

sentences.en: Paul Skeens has the capability over the next two or three years of starting to finish games, Sherrington says.
sentences.zh: 保罗·斯基恩斯在未来两三年内有能力开始投完比赛，谢林顿说。

sentences.en: Skeens hopes so.
sentences.zh: 斯基恩斯也希望如此。

sentences.en: As a former position player, he's accustomed to being in the lineup every day and rarely being removed during a game.
sentences.zh: 作为一名前位置球员，他习惯了每天都在阵容中，并且很少在比赛中被换下。

sentences.en: The goal is to go out there and pitch nine innings every time, he says now.
sentences.zh: 他现在说，目标是每次上场都投满九局。

sentences.en: That's not going to happen, but I try to get outs as quickly and efficiently as possible and hopefully have the bullpen throw as little as possible.
sentences.zh: 那是不可能发生的，但我尽量高效地取得出局数，希望牛棚投球越少越好。

sentences.en: Such efficiency was crucial when starters expected to get through games.
sentences.zh: 当先发投手预期能投完比赛时，这种效率至关重要。

sentences.en: These days, it clashes with another dictum of baseball analytics, that the only controllable outcome of an at-bat for a pitcher, at least in a positive sense, is the strikeout.
sentences.zh: 如今，它与棒球分析学的另一条准则相冲突，即对于投手来说，至少在积极意义上，打席中唯一可控的结果就是三振。

sentences.en: Once a ball is hit, what happens next will depend on an amalgamation of factors, including the ability of the fielders, how hard the wind is blowing, and pure luck.
sentences.zh: 一旦球被击出，接下来发生什么将取决于多种因素的结合，包括防守球员的能力、风力大小以及纯粹的运气。

sentences.en: Those lazy outfield flies might just end up in the stands.
sentences.zh: 那些看似无力的外野飞球可能刚好落入看台。

sentences.en: To avoid that, when pitchers get ahead in the count, they usually throw a pitcher to nowhere near the plate.
sentences.zh: 为了避免这种情况，当投手在球数领先时，他们通常会投出一颗远离好球带的球。

sentences.en: You're going out of the zone, in the dirt, just hoping they swing, says Logan Gilbert of the Seattle Mariners, whose 208 and two-thirds innings last season led the majors.
sentences.zh: 西雅图水手队的洛根·吉尔伯特说，你投出好球带，投到土里，只是希望他们挥棒。他上赛季投了208又2/3局，领跑大联盟。

sentences.en: Trying to induce swings can add a couple of pitches per batter, the difference between finishing the sixth inning at 75 pitches and an untenable 95.
sentences.zh: 试图诱导挥棒可能会让每位打者多投几球，这足以造成在75球时结束第六局和在难以接受的95球时结束比赛的区别。

sentences.en: Strikeouts also get pitchers noticed.
sentences.zh: 三振也能让投手受到关注。

sentences.en: That's what gets you drafted high and moves you through the minors, says Daniel Bard, a former first-round pick who pitched parts of nine seasons in the majors.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·巴德说，这就是让你在选秀中获得高顺位并在小联盟中晋升的原因。他曾是首轮秀，在大联盟投了九个赛季的部分时间。

sentences.en: If you can do that while keeping your walks down, you can be really, really good.
sentences.zh: 如果你能在保持低保送率的同时做到这一点，你就能变得非常、非常出色。

sentences.en: Skeens' frequency of striking out hitters is the highest of any pirate ever, but he knows that also compromises his ability to work deep into games.
sentences.zh: 斯基恩斯的三振率是海盗队史上最高的，但他知道这也影响了他深入比赛的能力。

sentences.en: To Skeens, every at-bat should end in three pitches, a three-pitch strikeout.
sentences.zh: 对斯基恩斯来说，每个打席都应该以三球结束，即三球三振。

sentences.en: But at some point, I'm like, okay, let's get this at-bat over with, and he'll throw a pitch designed to get a ground ball.
sentences.zh: 但有时我会想，好吧，让我们结束这个打席，然后他会投出一颗旨在制造滚地球的球。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, I want to put up as many zeros as possible, he says, referring to scoreless innings.
sentences.zh: 他说，归根结底，我想尽可能多地挂零，他指的是无失分局。

sentences.en: But if it's just five innings and no runs,
sentences.zh: 但如果只是投了五局且没有失分，

sentences.en: I'm not super happy about that either.
sentences.zh: 我对此也不是特别高兴。

sentences.en: Neither is Manfred.
sentences.zh: 曼弗雷德也不高兴。

sentences.en: Lately, Major League Baseball has shown a willingness to tinker with its rules, counteracting some of the stultifying effects of analytics-driven baseball.
sentences.zh: 最近，美国职棒大联盟表现出愿意调整规则的意愿，以抵消分析驱动型棒球带来的一些令人窒息的影响。

sentences.en: Among other adjustments, it outlawed the shifting of fielders from one side of second base to the other and enlarged the bases.
sentences.zh: 在其他调整中，它禁止了防守球员从二垒一侧换到另一侧，并加大了垒包。

sentences.en: After last season, when Skeens' 11-3 record and ERA under 2.0 focused attention on how the role of even the top starters has changed,
sentences.zh: 上赛季结束后，当斯基恩斯以11胜3负、防御率低于2.0的成绩让人们关注到顶级先发投手的角色发生了怎样的变化时，

sentences.en: many of the sports stakeholders expected Manfred to issue some kind of edict about pitching, possibly a rule change that might be provisionally implemented in a minor league
sentences.zh: 许多体育利益相关者预计曼弗雷德会发布某种关于投球的法令，可能是一项可能在小联盟暂时实施的规则变更，

sentences.en: so that the ramifications could be studied.
sentences.zh: 以便研究其后果。

sentences.en: Instead, MLB released a report on pitching injuries that revealed little that wasn't already known.
sentences.zh: 相反，MLB发布了一份关于投球伤病的报告，其中揭示的内容几乎都是已知的。

sentences.en: I haven't even read it, Skeens says.
sentences.zh: 斯基恩斯说，我甚至还没读过它。

sentences.en: Manfred describes himself as uncomfortable restricting how teams deploy their pitchers during games.
sentences.zh: 曼弗雷德形容自己对限制球队在比赛中如何调配投手感到不舒服。

sentences.en: I don't see how you can in the context of competition, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不明白在竞争的环境下怎么能这样做。

sentences.en: Instead, he suggests limiting how often pitchers can be recalled from the minors or how many can be on a roster.
sentences.zh: 相反，他建议限制投手从下放小联盟的召回频率，或者限制名单上的人数。

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, pitchers favor financial rewards, such as a bonus for anyone who throws 180 innings in a season.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，投手们更青睐经济奖励，例如给单赛季投满180局的任何人发放奖金。

sentences.en: A more oblique solution, one suggested to me by Fitzgerald of the Diamondbacks, would award additional draft picks to the teams whose starters remain in the game
sentences.zh: 一个更间接的解决方案，由响尾蛇队的菲茨杰拉德向我提出，即奖励那些先发投手在比赛中留场时间最长的球队额外的选秀权，

sentences.en: the longest over the course of a season.
sentences.zh: 这是在整个赛季的过程中计算的。

sentences.en: Such remedies would have consequences, though.
sentences.zh: 然而，这样的补救措施会有后果。

sentences.en: The pitchers who throw the most would include the majority of baseball's best starters, many of whom would very likely end up on the best and wealthiest teams,
sentences.zh: 投球局数最多的投手将包括大多数棒球界最好的先发投手，其中许多人很可能会最终去到最好、最富有的球队，

sentences.en: the last ones you'd want getting additional draft picks.
sentences.zh: 而那些球队正是你最不希望获得额外选秀权的。

sentences.en: And roster limits would force the one-inning relievers to work two or three innings, which is like making sprinters suddenly start running the mile.
sentences.zh: 而且名单限制会迫使那些一局制的后援投手投两到三局，这就像让短跑运动员突然开始跑一英里。

sentences.en: If you start messing with the rosters, you're going to crush those guys, Scherzer says.
sentences.zh: 谢泽尔说，如果你开始干扰名单，你就会毁了这些家伙。

sentences.en: You're going to create injuries.
sentences.zh: 你会造成伤病。

sentences.en: Already, baseball is straining to accommodate those pitchers whose elbows, shoulders, or other body parts have failed under the strain of throwing balls at such high velocities.
sentences.zh: 棒球界已经在努力应对那些因以如此高球速投球而导致手肘、肩膀或其他身体部位受损的投手。

sentences.en: Last season, 390 pitchers, 13 per team, spent time on MLB's injury list, missing a total of more than 33,000 days.
sentences.zh: 上赛季，有390名投手（每队13人）进入了MLB的伤病名单，总共缺席了超过33,000天。

sentences.en: And if you're on the injured list, you aren't throwing any innings at all.
sentences.zh: 如果你在伤病名单上，你就根本投不了球。

sentences.en: Injuries to pitchers are already such a problem, in fact, that strenuous effort is made to avoid them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，投手伤病已经是一个如此严重的问题，以至于人们付出了巨大的努力来避免它们。

sentences.en: The professional life of a pitcher used to consist primarily of pitching, in games and in bullpen sessions between them.
sentences.zh: 投手职业生涯过去主要由投球组成，包括在比赛中和比赛间的牛棚训练。

sentences.en: When Jim Cott, who worked in more than 900 big league games over a 25-year career, served as a pitching coach for the Cincinnati Reds in the 1980s,
sentences.zh: 当吉姆·科特在25年的职业生涯中参与了900多场大联盟比赛，并在1980年代担任辛辛那提红人队的投球教练时，

sentences.en: he instructed starters to never go more than a day without throwing as much as they would throw in a game.
sentences.zh: 他指示先发投手每天投球量不得少于比赛中的投球量。

sentences.en: He believed that pitchers shouldn't expect to complete a nine-inning game if they couldn't even do that in practice.
sentences.zh: 他认为，如果投手在练习中都做不到，就不应该指望能完成一场九局的比赛。

sentences.en: These days, the act of actually throwing a ball toward a batter has been scaffolded with a regimen of exercises designed to increase velocity, but also, theoretically at least,
sentences.zh: 如今，向打者投球的行为已经被一系列旨在提高球速的锻炼方案所支撑，但至少在理论上，

sentences.en: to help prevent the ligament tears and other breakdowns that are prematurely ending seasons and even careers.
sentences.zh: 也是为了帮助防止导致赛季甚至职业生涯提前结束的韧带撕裂和其他崩溃。

sentences.en: Pitchers are certainly throwing harder, yet they're still getting hurt.
sentences.zh: 投手们确实投得更用力了，但他们仍然在受伤。

sentences.en: And it may be that, to Cott's point, all this scaffolding at the expense of throwing is increasing the likelihood that complete games will, like 400 batting averages,
sentences.zh: 而且可能正如科特所言，所有这些以牺牲投球为代价的支撑训练，正在增加完投像4成打击率一样，

sentences.en: soon exist only in the record books.
sentences.zh: 很快只会存在于记录簿中的可能性。

sentences.en: One recent Thursday in Bradenton,
sentences.zh: 最近一个周四在布雷登顿，

sentences.en: Skeens stood under a portico outside the Pirates' clubhouse at 9 a.m., swinging a weighted pendulum.
sentences.zh: 斯基恩斯早上9点站在海盗队更衣室外的门廊下，摆动着一个加重摆锤。

sentences.en: After that, he picked up a medicine ball and hurled it against a concrete wall in a simulacrum of his pitching motion.
sentences.zh: 之后，他拿起一个药球，模拟投球动作将其扔向水泥墙。

sentences.en: Next, he strapped an oversized plastic tube filled with water onto his back, stepped to the top of a ramp with the same downward slope as a pitching mound,
sentences.zh: 接下来，他背上一个装满水的大号塑料管，走到一个与投手丘坡度相同的坡道顶端，

sentences.en: and took a stride while flinging his right shoulder forward.
sentences.zh: 迈出一步，同时将右肩向前甩出。

sentences.en: He grabbed a weighted ball and flipped it backhanded against the wall, then threw it from the top of the ramp.
sentences.zh: 他抓起一个加重球反手扔向墙壁，然后从坡道顶端投出。

sentences.en: Satisfied, he walked under the stands and onto the field.
sentences.zh: 心满意足后，他走过看台下方，进入了球场。

sentences.en: Still, he wasn't ready to pitch.
sentences.zh: 不过，他还没准备好投球。

sentences.en: He spent the next few minutes tossing a football to a coach.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几分钟里，他一直在和一位教练抛接橄榄球。

sentences.en: He continued his game of catch with a baseball.
sentences.zh: 随后，他又继续玩起了棒球传接球游戏。

sentences.en: When that was finished, he went back under the stands and across a brilliant green lawn to a mound, where Jason DeLay, one of Pittsburgh's catchers, waited in full gear.
sentences.zh: 结束后，他回到看台下，穿过一片翠绿的草坪，来到投手丘前。匹兹堡海盗队的捕手之一杰森·德莱（Jason DeLay）已全副武装在那里等候。

sentences.en: Skeens tossed a ball to DeLay from in front of the mound a few times.
sentences.zh: 斯基恩斯（Skeens）在投手丘前向德莱投了几次球。

sentences.en: Then he stepped back on the rubber, and for the first time that day, started to throw actual pitches.
sentences.zh: 接着，他站上投手踏板，当天第一次开始正式投球。

sentences.en: As he threw,
sentences.zh: 在他投球时，

sentences.en: Charrington watched.
sentences.zh: 查林顿（Charrington）在一旁注视着。

sentences.en: He was monitoring his investment, but he was also clearly transfixed by the spectacle.
sentences.zh: 他既是在评估自己的投资，显然也被这番景象深深吸引了。

sentences.en: Three Pirates coaches were clustered a few feet away, paying close attention.
sentences.zh: 三名海盗队的教练聚在几英尺外，密切关注着。

sentences.en: And underneath the portico, a group of players had stopped their own workouts to stare across the lawn at their prodigious teammate who pitches in a game, on average,
sentences.zh: 在门廊下，一群球员也停下了各自的训练，隔着草坪注视着他们那位天赋异禀的队友，他平均每场比赛

sentences.en: only around once a week.
sentences.zh: 大约只投一次球。

sentences.en: Last year, Skeens' most effective pitch was a hybrid of a traditional sinker and a split-fingered fastball called the splinker,
sentences.zh: 去年，斯基恩斯最有效的球种是一种结合了传统沉球和指叉快速球的混合球，被称为“沉指球”（splinker），

sentences.en: which tends to veer sharply downward as it nears the plate.
sentences.zh: 这种球在接近本垒板时往往会急剧下坠。

sentences.en: As Skeens worked in the sunshine, he threw splinkers and four-seam fastballs and sliders, curves, and change-ups.
sentences.zh: 当斯基恩斯在阳光下训练时，他投出了沉指球、四缝线快速球、滑球、曲球和变速球。

sentences.en: He also experimented with a fastball thrown with his fingers atop the seams of the ball rather than across them, and a cutter designed to tail away from right-handed hitters.
sentences.zh: 他还尝试了一种手指压在球缝上方而非横跨球缝的快速球，以及一种旨在远离右打者的切球。

sentences.en: One fastball seemed to be even faster than the reSt.
sentences.zh: 其中一个快速球似乎比其他的都要快。

sentences.en: It hit the catcher's mitt with an audible boom rather than a pop.
sentences.zh: 它撞击捕手手套时发出的不是清脆的“啪”声，而是一声沉闷的巨响。

sentences.en: It turned out to be the last pitch.
sentences.zh: 这成了他投出的最后一球。

sentences.en: After he caught it,
sentences.zh: 接住球后，

sentences.en: Belay stood up and walked toward Skeens, and the coaches converged.
sentences.zh: 德莱站起身走向斯基恩斯，教练们也围了过来。

sentences.en: Skeens had thrown 35 pitches, the equivalent of three brisk innings.
sentences.zh: 斯基恩斯一共投了35球，相当于三局快节奏的投球量。

sentences.en: That must have been enough because everyone bumped fists.
sentences.zh: 这应该足够了，因为大家都碰拳示意。

sentences.en: Another pitcher was scheduled to use the mound, so Skeens moved aside and started chatting with a couple of teammates.
sentences.zh: 另一位投手预定要使用投手丘，于是斯基恩斯让到一边，开始和几位队友聊天。

sentences.en: It was just past 9.30 a.m., and his day of throwing was done.
sentences.zh: 当时刚过上午9点半，他一天的投球训练就此结束。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》（Metro）节目中，我，莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig），将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
